---
title: Choose a model
description: Leave the model on Auto, or pick a named model for your next messages.
sidebar:
  order: 5
---

The builder runs on an AI model. By default **Auto** picks the best one for each request, and for most sites that is all you need. If you would rather choose, you can pick a named model from the same menu that holds the mode.

1. Click the chip at the bottom of the chat box, for example **Auto · Build**. On **New agent** and **Home**, the model control **Auto** sits next to the **Build** / **Brainstorm** toggle.
2. Under **Select model** (**Choose how STEPS routes this turn**), leave **Auto** (**Best model for each request**) selected, or look under **Choose model** (**Pick a model for this run**) and click a model in the list.
3. Send your message. It runs with the model the chip now shows.

![The chip in the chat box opened: Select model with Auto ticked, a short Choose model list beneath it, and Run mode at the bottom.](/images/build/choose-model-1.webp)

Changing the model does not start anything by itself. It only changes how your next message is handled.

## Good to know

- The list under **Choose model** changes over time, so this guide does not name models. The menu always shows what is available now.
- The chip is greyed out while the builder is working. Change the model between messages.
- If the chip reads **Loading models**, wait a moment. If it reads **Models unavailable**, click it to try again.
- The same menu holds the mode. See [Build and Brainstorm](/build/modes/).
